data.task_title: Create Artemis self-demo with Chart.js visualization

features.title: Live Metrics Dashboard
features.description: Develop a real-time dashboard with Chart.js graphs for LLM cost, stage completion rates, and success rate trends.
acceptance_criteria: LLM cost over time is shown using a line chart.
Stage completion rates are displayed with a bar chart.
Success rate trends are visualized with an area chart.

features.title: Chart.js Visualization Integration
features.description: Integrate Chart.js to create visualizations for pipeline metrics, cost tracking, and success rates.
acceptance_criteria: Pipeline metrics are visualized using Chart.js.
Cost tracking is displayed with appropriate charts.
Success rates are shown using Chart.js visualizations.

features.title: Code Quality Metrics Visualization
features.description: Visualize TDD compliance and SOLID principles using a radar chart.
acceptance_criteria: TDD compliance is represented in the radar chart.
SOLID principles are visualized in the radar chart.
The radar chart is clear and informative.

features.title: 8-Stage Pipeline Visualization
acceptance_criteria: All 8 stages of the pipeline are represented in the visualization.
The visualization is clear and easy to understand.
Chart.js is used to create the pipeline visualization.

features.title: Results Section with Real Metrics
features.description: Display real metrics from recent runs using actual data.
acceptance_criteria: Real metrics from recent runs are included in the presentation.
Data is accurate and up-to-date.
Metrics are presented in a clear and engaging manner.

features.title: HTML Presentation Creation
features.description: Develop a standalone HTML file showcasing Artemis capabilities using embedded CSS, JavaScript, and Chart.js.
acceptance_criteria: The HTML file is standalone with no external dependencies.
CSS and JavaScript are embedded within the HTML file.
Chart.js is included for data visualization.

features.title: Hero Section: Introduction to Artemis
features.description: Create a hero section introducing Artemis as an Autonomous AI Development System.
acceptance_criteria: The hero section clearly explains what Artemis is.
The design is visually engaging and informative.
Key features of Artemis are highlighted.

features.title: Interactive Elements and Animations
features.description: Enhance the presentation with Chart.js animations and interactive elements.
acceptance_criteria: Chart.js animations are used to enhance visualizations.
Interactive elements are included to engage users.
The presentation remains responsive and user-friendly.

features.title: Auto-Advance and Navigation Controls
features.description: Implement auto-advance functionality with navigation controls for the presentation.
acceptance_criteria: Slides auto-advance after a specified duration.
Users can manually navigate through slides using controls.
Navigation controls are intuitive and responsive.

features.title: Professional Presentation Design
features.description: Design the presentation with a professional gradient background and smooth transitions.
acceptance_criteria: A gradient background is applied consistently across slides.
Transitions between slides are smooth and professional.
The design aligns with the Artemis branding.

features.title: Supervisor Integration Visualization
features.description: Show supervisor integration across stages using a pie chart.
acceptance_criteria: A pie chart represents supervisor integration across stages.
The chart is clear and accurately represents data.
Chart.js is used for the pie chart visualization.
